code_improvements.title: Add Teams CRUD Router
code_improvements.description: Create a full CRUD API router for the teams and teamMembers tables. The database schema already defines teams and teamMembers tables with proper relationships, but no API routes exist. This would enable team creation, member management, and role assignment.
code_improvements.rationale: The teams and teamMembers tables exist in server/src/db/schema.ts with full schema definitions (team name, owner, members with roles). The CRUD router pattern is well-established in brands.ts, designs.ts, and images.ts - this is a direct copy with table name changes. Teams are referenced by brandProfiles (team_id FK exists), showing the data model is ready.
existing_patterns: server/src/routes/brands.ts - Full CRUD with ownership verification
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create server/src/routes/teams.ts following brands.ts structure exactly. 2. Import teams and teamMembers from schema. 3. Add routes: GET / (list user's teams), POST / (create team), GET /:id (get team with members), PATCH /:id (update team), DELETE /:id (delete team), POST /:id/members (add member), DELETE /:id/members/:userId (remove member), PATCH /:id/members/:userId (change role). 4. Register in index.ts with app.route('/api/teams', teamRouter).

code_improvements.title: Add Voice Transcripts API Route
code_improvements.description: Create an API route to list, search, and export voice transcripts. The voiceTranscripts table stores all voice interactions but users have no way to review, search, or export their voice history.
code_improvements.rationale: The voiceTranscripts table exists with fields for userId, conversationId, role, content, audioDurationMs, toolCalls, and provider. The chatMessages route (server/src/routes/chat.ts) already provides identical functionality for chat messages. This is a small extension applying the same pattern to voice data.
existing_patterns: server/src/routes/chat.ts - Messages list with conversation scoping
server/src/routes/prompts.ts - List with search and category filters
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create server/src/routes/voice.ts with Hono router. 2. Add GET /transcripts endpoint with filters: date range, provider (gemini/openai), search in content. 3. Add GET /transcripts/export for JSON/CSV export of transcript history. 4. Follow prompts.ts for search/filter query param patterns. 5. Include pagination with limit/offset. 6. Register in index.ts.

code_improvements.title: Add Design Owner Comments Management
code_improvements.description: Enable design owners to view, resolve, and delete comments on their designs. Currently comments are only accessible via shared links - owners cannot manage feedback on their own designs.
code_improvements.rationale: The comments table exists and is used via sharing.ts public routes. The isResolved field exists but has no toggle route. Design owners should be able to: list all comments on their designs, mark comments as resolved, delete inappropriate comments. The toggle pattern exists in prompts.ts (toggle-favorite) and designs.ts (toggle-public).
existing_patterns: server/src/routes/sharing.ts - Comment creation on shared designs
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add authenticated routes to sharing.ts: GET /designs/:designId/comments (list comments for owned design), POST /comments/:id/resolve (toggle isResolved), DELETE /comments/:id (delete comment). 2. Each route verifies design ownership via designs table userId check. 3. Follow the existing toggle-favorite pattern from prompts.ts for the resolve toggle. 4. Add filters for resolved/unresolved in list endpoint.

code_improvements.title: Add Batch Delete Designs Command
code_improvements.description: Add a voice/AI command for batch deleting multiple designs from the gallery. The pattern exists for batch operations on canvas elements but not for gallery cleanup.
code_improvements.rationale: BatchDeleteElementsCommand, BatchUpscaleCommand, and BatchRemoveBackgroundCommand already exist in the command system demonstrating the batch pattern. Users may want to clean up multiple old designs at once. The Command interface and ActionExecutor registration pattern are well established.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. In galleryCommands.ts, add BatchDeleteDesignsCommand class implementing Command. 2. Accept args: { design_ids: string[] }. 3. Loop through IDs calling deleteDesignFromDb for each, collecting results/errors like BatchUpscaleCommand does. 4. Return aggregated result: { success: X, errors: Y }. 5. Register in actionExecutor.ts with this.registerCommand(new BatchDeleteDesignsCommand()). 6. Add to ToolSchemas for validation.

code_improvements.title: Implement LangfuseService getDailyMetrics
code_improvements.description: Complete the stubbed getDailyMetrics method in LangfuseService to aggregate and return daily usage statistics from Langfuse traces.
code_improvements.rationale: LangfuseService.getDailyMetrics() exists but returns empty array with comment 'for now, let's focus on Traces'. The getTraces method shows the working pattern for Langfuse API calls with proper auth headers. The dailyStats table exists in schema for storing aggregated metrics. AdminObservability page likely expects this data.
existing_patterns: server/src/services/langfuse.ts - getTraces method with Langfuse API auth
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. In langfuse.ts getDailyMetrics, follow getTraces pattern for API calls. 2. Fetch traces for date range, aggregate by day: totalRequests, totalTokens, uniqueUsers, errorCount. 3. Option A: Compute from traces API if Langfuse supports date filtering. Option B: Store daily aggregates in dailyStats table via scheduled job and query from DB. 4. Return array of { date, metrics } objects matching dailyStats schema. 5. Add error handling matching getTraces pattern.
